name: West Glacier KOA Resort
note: Big KOA resort on Halfmoon Flats Rd, 3 km from Glacier's West Entrance; patio, full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pool. RV sites $145-269 a night before tax for a mid-June 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 5*, $$$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/west-glacier/reserve/) quoted 2027-06-15, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: water/electric $145, full hookups $185, patio $205-269 (read 2026-10-19); Google 4.7 over 1,267 reviews; RV Life 5* over 535 reviews, 227 sites; Glacier NP gateway (3 km from an entrance, gateways.py), so the price gate is lifted
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) at 48.4647,-113.9812 read 2026-10-19: site loops cut into conifer forest south of Halfmoon Flats Rd; no water in the 800 m frame; not waterfront

name: St. Mary / East Glacier KOA Holiday
note: KOA on West Shore Rd at St. Mary, about 1 km from Glacier's St. Mary entrance; full-hookup, patio and water/electric RV sites, pool. RV sites $96-160 a night before tax for a mid-June 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4*, $$$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/st-mary/reserve/) quoted 2027-06-15, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: water/electric $96, full hookups $115-138, patio $160 (read 2026-10-19); Google 4.2 over 869 reviews; RV Life 4* over 442 reviews, 140 sites; Glacier NP gateway (1 km from an entrance, gateways.py), so the price gate is lifted
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) at 48.7580,-113.4370 read 2026-10-19: open-grass site loops east of West Shore Rd; the St. Mary River bends past the east edge ~150-250 m from the nearest pads behind a belt of forest; not waterfront

name: Whitefish / Kalispell North KOA Holiday
note: KOA in the pines off US-93 between Whitefish and Kalispell, about 31 km from Glacier's West Entrance; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $105-155 a night before tax for a mid-June 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4*, $$$$. --Claude
